subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Emulators vs Real Devices
description: One-minute skill: Emulators vs Real Devices.

hook.text: Tests pass on the emulator. On a real phone, the app overheats and the touchscreen stops responding.

buildup.text: Emulators simulate devices in software. They're fast and free but miss hardware-specific behaviors.

discovery.text: Real devices reveal performance issues, touch accuracy problems, and hardware quirks that emulators hide.

twist.text: The best strategy uses both: emulators for fast iteration, real devices for final validation.

climax.text: A bug where the camera API crashes on Samsung devices is caught only on the real device, not the emulator.

punchline.text: Emulators for speed. Real devices for truth.

quiz.question: What do real devices reveal that emulators miss?
